result.title: OmniPersist: Persistent Dynamic World Modeling via Coupled Panoramic Evolution
result.summary: Action-conditioned world models play a vital role in robotics and autonomous driving, yet existing video diffusion models struggle to maintain dynamic object persistence. When the camera turns away and returns, out-of-view moving entities fail to evolve plausibly in latent space, often mutating or vanishing entirely due to bounded perspective views. To resolve this issue, we propose OmniPersist, a unified framework that couples perspective video generation with panoramic evolution within a single-stage diffusion model, without relying on auxiliary models or initial panoramic inputs. To maintain efficiency, we model the panoramic stream at a lower frame rate, bridging both views across space and time via Geometric Anchoring (GeoAnch) for spatial correspondence and Temporal Compensation (TemComp) for temporal aggregation. OmniPersist is agnostic to camera-control architectures, supporting both latent-level and attention-level conditioning. Extensive experiments on a newly constructed dynamic benchmark across image-to-video and video continuation tasks demonstrate consistent gains in visual quality, camera controllability, revisit consistency, and dynamic persistence.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 OmniPersist，在单阶段扩散模型中耦合透视视频生成与低帧率全景演化，用几何锚定做空间对应、时间补偿做时序聚合，使镜头离开后视野外的运动实体在 latent 中持续合理演化，并在新构建的动态基准上评测重访一致性与动态持续性。
AI.relevance_reason: 其为视频世界模型而非 VLM 推理工作，但「视野外实体在 latent 中持续演化、重访时保持一致」的状态保持与重访校验问题表述，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态能否保存并复用暂时离开视野的视觉证据提供概念参考，需核查其 latent 条件与时间聚合是否可迁移。
